title: Site registry - the sites one framework deployment serves
description: Shape of the built-in defaults (shared/sites/registry.default.json) and of the framework-storage override (config/sites-registry.json); both are documents of this shape. framework/core/site_registry.py merges the override over the defaults BY SITE NAME: a present field replaces the default, null resets a field to its derived default, objects deep-merge, lists replace. A site the defaults do not define is appended in override order and must then carry domain, repo_path and branch. Checked after merging, beyond this schema: no two sites (disabled ones included) share a domain, repo_path, seo_site_yaml file or DSN env var, and at least one site stays enabled (#/definitions/site is the resolved shape SiteEntry.to_dict() returns). Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. framework/tests/test_site_registry.py keeps this schema and the module's own validator in agreement.

schema_version.description: Document version. Optional in a storage override; must be "1" when present.

replace_sites.description: Storage override only. true drops every site the built-in defaults define, so the override's 'sites' is the complete list (a different deployment of the framework); it must still define at least one enabled site. The template lists still come from the defaults unless the override sets them.

producer_templates.description: Registry-wide producer templates ('*-<suffix>'; '*' becomes the site's agent_prefix). Every site inherits this list unless it sets its own producer_templates. The order is the backlog dispatcher's walk order: producer ids are expanded template by template, and within one template site by site.

content_agent_templates.description: Registry-wide templates for a site's content-production agents: the agents that take the site's content_tier in the priority ladder. Inherited unless a site sets its own.

sites.description: Ordered list of site entries (in the override: patches matched by name). The order is meaningful: sites are enumerated in it, and it is the site order inside each template when producer ids are expanded. Names must be unique within one document.

site_name.description: Lowercase kebab-case slug: the RESPONDER_SITE value, the editorial site key, the key every consumer uses.

domain.description: Bare lowercase hostname, no scheme and no path (e.g. example.com).

abs_path.description: Absolute POSIX path without a trailing slash.

env_name.description: The NAME of an environment variable (never its value).

yaml_path.description: Path to a YAML file. Relative paths resolve against the framework repo root; absolute paths are used as they are.

goal_id.description: A goal id in the agent-goals.schema.json format.

template.description: Agent-id template '*-<suffix>'; '*' is replaced by the site's agent_prefix (the same template form framework/core/dependencies.py uses).

agent_ref.description: A full agent id, or a '*-<suffix>' template expanded with the site's agent_prefix.

extra.description: Free-form, consumer-specific values that are not first-class fields yet. Deep-merged by the override. Promote a key to a real field once a second consumer reads it.

site_patch.description: One site entry in a document. Only 'name' is required here: in the storage override an entry for a site the defaults already define is a patch. Every other field may be null, meaning 'use the derived default'.

label.description: Display name for digests and dashboards. Derived default: the name, title-cased.

domain.description: The site's public hostname. Required once merged.

repo_path.description: Absolute path of the site's git checkout on the fleet host (the path is a contract: manifests and the implementer hardcode it). Required once merged.

branch.description: Branch the implementer commits to. Required once merged.

seo_site_yaml.description: The site's SEO site.yaml (the implementer's SEO_AGENT_CONFIG fallback). Relative to the framework repo root unless absolute. Derived default: examples/sites/<name>.yaml.

dsn_env.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the site's Postgres DSN. Derived default: DATABASE_URL_<NAME> (upper-cased, '-' becomes '_'). The value is read only by site_registry.dsn_for() and is never logged.

dsn_env_aliases.description: Other env var NAMES some consumers read for the same DSN, in fallback order. dsn_for() tries them only when asked to (include_aliases=True, or names=[...] for one particular convention).

agent_prefix.description: Prefix of the site's per-site agent ids ('<prefix>-seo-opportunity-agent'). Derived default: the name.

accent.description: Accent colour for the site's digest and goals cards.

kpi_goal_id.description: The site-goals-tracker goal shown as the site's headline KPI.

starvation.description: Whether the site takes part in the priority starvation rebalance (a site with a starved content pipeline is boosted). Default false: a new or gated site would otherwise be boosted permanently.

content_tier.description: Priority tier for the site's content agents (content_agent_templates). null leaves them to the priority config's patterns and default tier.

producer_templates.description: This site's producer templates; replaces the registry-wide list for this site. [] means no templated producers.

producer_extras.description: Explicit extra producers for this site (full agent ids or templates), walked after the templated producers.

content_agent_templates.description: This site's content-agent templates; replaces the registry-wide list for this site.

dispatch_group.description: Producer ids are expanded group by group in ascending order; inside a group, template by template across the group's sites. A higher group keeps a site's producers behind every lower group's in the dispatcher walk. Derived default: 0 for a site the built-in defaults define; one more than the highest built-in group for a site only the storage override defines, so a new site never takes a dispatch slot ahead of a built-in producer unless it sets this.

enabled.description: false keeps the site known (get_site, site_for_agent) but leaves it out of every enumeration: list_sites, producer ids, starvation sites, content tiers. Default true.

site.description: A resolved site entry (SiteEntry.to_dict()): every field present, derived defaults filled in.
